title: Admin Console — Composed Admin Panel
description: The ideal admin panel as a portable slice. A gated two-column shell + a harvested section registry (26 sections across observability / identity / ai / content / commerce / config) distilled from ~15 project admin panels. Reuse sections mount existing rr slices by id (users, RBAC, AI, blog, services, comments, newsletter, settings, media, audit); the consumer supplies those components via a `components` map so the slice never hard-imports a peer. Ships 5 net-new gap sections nothing else covered — Analytics, Audit-log viewer, Navigation config, SEO health, Leads/CRM inbox — each adapter-driven with an in-memory mock so the whole console is interactive with zero backend. Access is injected (no hard Convex import); gate logic is pure + unit-tested. Convex copy-source (ac_leads, ac_nav_items) is composed into the consumer's own backend.
